morphology.pattern_note: 依输入包保留为未分析的整词；尚未确认其马来语词根身份、标准读音或构词规则。作为专名时写作 Suyambu。

senses.zh_definition: 专名拼写 Suyambu，可见于南亚人名及印度教寺庙名称；现有资料不足以确定输入词在原文中的具体所指，也不足以将其确认为标准马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: An attested spelling used in South Asian personal and Hindu temple names; the intended referent and any standard Malay lexical meaning remain unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan nama khas yang ditemukan dalam nama orang dan nama kuil Hindu di Asia Selatan; rujukan khusus dalam input dan maknanya sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处 pos=noun 表示专名用途。未查得可核实的 DBP 马来语释义，不应标为 official。以下搭配和例句为说明专名书写而自拟，并非经语料统计的高频搭配。人名用例见[印度国家医学委员会公开文件](https://www.nmc.org.in/MCIRest/open/getDocument?path=%2FDocuments%2FPublic%2FPortal%2FMeetings%2FGeneral_Body%2F2007%2F11%2F16%2FMNGB+16.11.07+%282%29.pdf)；宗教名称用例见[马来西亚寺庙资料页](https://temple-indian.my/aalayam/ramayana-cave-suyambu-lingam/)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 专名资料核对；自拟例句
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila semak ejaan nama Suyambu sebelum surat itu dikeluarkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 发出信函前，请核对 Suyambu 这个名字的拼写。
dual_scenarios.en: Please check the spelling of the name Suyambu before issuing the letter.

kat 在此表示位置，对应标准语 dalam。
tu 对应 itu；句末 ke 表示口语疑问。

etymology.historical_story: Suyambu appears in personal names and Hindu temple names, but those attestations do not establish a Malay common noun. Its occurrence in Malaysian religious settings illustrates how names travel with communities while retaining their identity. Without the original passage, assigning this token a particular religious meaning or a definitive borrowing history would go beyond the evidence.
